scripts.setup: npm install && npm run prisma:generate -w apps/api && npm run db:migrate -w apps/api && npm run seed -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run db -w apps/api" "node scripts/wait-port.mjs 51214 180 && npm run db:migrate -w apps/api && npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
